title: [WAN] VPN routes not reaching rr1 from pe1
symptom: Customer VPN routes originating from DC1 are not visible on pe2 or rr1. BGP sessions appear up across the backbone. Triage using multivendor WAN orchestrator.
root_cause: export policy removed from protocols bgp group ibgp-rr on pe1 — VPN routes not advertised to rr1
fix_command: set protocols bgp group ibgp-rr export EXPORT-TO-RR
